Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria

Thanks for the call today — happy with the direction. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood can serve our recommendation generation model at <100ms 95th p95 and with acceptable token costs.
- Success criteria (initial): throughput 200 req/s sustained on 1 model variant, tail latency <150ms, model outputs match quality baseline on our eval set (F1 >= 0.82).
- Timeline: target 4-week POC starting May 18.

I'll loop in Marco (engineering) and our IT team for network / infra requirements. Please send the POC scope doc and a risk tracker template.

Jamie
Head of ML Platform
Acme Corp

Jamie — thanks, this is helpful. Attached is the POC scope and the risk tracker CSV. Per our call, I captured the evaluation plan and owners below: 

- Success criteria owner: Jamie (Acme) + Marissa (Redwood) for acceptance.
- Evaluation plan: baseline eval set (shared), nightly end-to-end tests, manual review of 100 samples at midpoint.
- Milestones: Week 0 (prep & infra), Week 1 (initial deployment & smoke), Week 2 (load and quality eval), Week 3 (stabilize & tuning), Week 4 (final evaluation + decisions).

Next steps for now:
1) Marco / IT to confirm VPC peering and port access (see attached network_requirements_acme.xlsx).
2) Jamie to confirm success criteria items and add any additional metrics.
3) Rishi / Dev to provision dedicated test queue and pre-load model weights.

I've attached the scope doc and a thin risk tracker. I'll maintain the tracker and we can update weekly.

Best,
Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jamie Liu <jamie@acme.com>
Cc: Acme IT Team <it@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria

On our side: IT reviewed the network spreadsheet. We have two potential blockers:

1) TLS termination and outbound port policy — our security team requires egress through a proxy that may add latency.
2) We will need a static IP range or NAT mapping for the Redwood endpoint to allowlist.

We can try a staged approach: allowlist a small CIDR for the POC and monitor latency. If proxy adds >30ms at p95, we'll revert to a direct peered path.

I'll coordinate with IT for NAT info. ETA: we can confirm by May 14.

—Marco
Engineering Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@acme.com>, Jamie Liu <jamie@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria

Thanks Marco — that's helpful. Adding a quick risk table (summary) into the thread: 

- Risk 1: Egress proxy adds latency (>30ms p95) — Impact: could fail latency SLO -> Mitigation: allowlist small CIDR for peered endpoint; fall back to VPC peering with direct path. Owner: Acme IT / Redwood infra (Dev). Escalation: Rishi + Acme Security lead.

- Risk 2: Model mismatch / quality regression vs baseline — Impact: POC fail -> Mitigation: run nightly eval, freeze model version for A/B tests, fallback to lower-latency quantized variant. Owner: Jamie + Rishi. Escalation: Marissa + Redwood PM.

- Risk 3: Tokenization differences causing higher cost — Impact: cost exceed expectations -> Mitigation: run tokenized preprocess and estimate costs daily; test control prompts. Owner: Marissa + Acme ML Eng.

I'll track these in the attached CSV and update status each Friday. Can everyone confirm owners and the escalation path?

Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@acme.com>, Jamie Liu <jamie@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria

Quick status update — Day 1 of POC (May 18):

- Infrastructure: dedicated test queue provisioned and model variant deployed (Dev).
- Network: Acme allowed CIDR 34.210.0.0/24 for trial. Initial smoke shows 95th p95 ~120ms with proxy in place (good signal).
- Tests: Nightly eval scheduled; data sync completed for baseline eval set.

Open issues observed:
- ISSUE-1: Sporadic 503s under synthetic load at 200req/s when KV cache warmed — Dev investigating (potential concurrency bug).
  - Mitigation: reduce concurrency slightly, enable aggressive retry; Dev to patch by May 20.
- ISSUE-2: One prompt pattern shows low-quality hallucinations vs baseline (sample set id: ACME-HALL-34).
  - Mitigation: Rishi to run targeted eval and recommend prompt engineering / different model variant.

If we don't resolve ISSUE-1 by May 20, we'll open an escalation to infra pager and consider a temporary capacity bump.

Rishi
VP Eng, Redwood Inference

To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>

- For ISSUE-1: please mark as high priority. If patch ETA is May 20, we expect a fix and verification before midday. If not, open the escalation to infra pager and let us know the temporary capacity bump cost.

Jamie
